summary: Under D81 the pass covers four projects rather than ten, and every survivor ends the week with nothing broken on the evidence read today. Rising still carries a needs-attention verdict from its 2026-09-21 review, but the defect behind it is fixed: v0.73.0 added `campaign.restore_if_saved()`, and `source/ui/play_picker/play_picker.gd:70-71` calls it, so a relaunch now reads the campaign save back. The Gnosis lead finding from 2026-09-26 is fixed the same way, since `web/standing-api.mjs:56-57` and `web/downtime-api.mjs:66-67` both refuse a stale revision with a 409 the way `/api/pc` does. The work queue fell from 126 pending rows to 5, and 141 actions closed across the four projects this week. Two things remain. Spend on the four survivors rose 51 percent, and 14 of the 16 skills the desktop upload snapshot carries still differ from source with one of them truncated, due 2026-09-30, which only Kane's upload can meet.

topActions.label: Upload plugin/personal-skills-0.7.0.zip in the desktop application before 2026-09-30, then run check-plugin-snapshot.ps1 expecting zero splits; the snapshot differs from source on 14 of the 16 skills it carries, one of them truncated, and six further skills are absent from it.
Propagate the stalled field in data/projects.json to the homepage prose and badges, so Chains, Hordes, Budget and Ring stop reading as live.
Move the duplicate-key scan in test-data-integrity.mjs out of the herbs loop so it covers the alias and illustration maps on every run.
Add a skipped-day alarm for the daily ingest and lore audit, both of which skipped 2026-09-25 unnoticed.
Push the three sweep commits ahead of the remote so the public dashboard matches the canonical ledgers.
